workload_queries: SELECT t.title, t.production_year, n.name, ci.nr_order FROM title t JOIN cast_info ci ON t.id = ci.movie_id JOIN name n ON ci.person_id = n.id WHERE t.kind_id = 4 AND t.production_year >= 2010 AND ci.role_id = 1 ORDER BY t.production_year DESC, ci.nr_order

SELECT t.title, t.production_year, mk.keyword FROM title t JOIN movie_keyword mk ON t.id = mk.movie_id JOIN keyword k ON mk.keyword_id = k.id WHERE t.kind_id = 4 AND t.production_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 AND k.keyword IN ('action', 'adventure', 'sci-fi')

SELECT n.name, COUNT(*) as appearance_count, AVG(t.production_year) as avg_year FROM name n JOIN cast_info ci ON n.id = ci.person_id JOIN title t ON ci.movie_id = t.id WHERE t.kind_id = 4 AND t.production_year >= 2000 GROUP BY n.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY appearance_count DESC
